key_insight: Func-R1 tackles multimodal function reasoning by explicitly separating visual perception from symbolic reasoning to reduce modality interference in math tasks.
engineering_relevance: The paper suggests a practical training recipe for MLLMs that need reliable diagram-and-formula understanding in STEM applications, improving robustness on visual math benchmarks.
method: Decoupled architecture to separate perception and reasoning stages
Hierarchical post-training to first identify critical visual evidence, then perform deeper theoretical reasoning
Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization (PATO) to align policy updates with mathematical properties and correct visual information during reasoning
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive benchmark gains across diverse evaluations, including an 8.4% improvement over GPT-5 on MathVerse function-oriented tasks.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of visual evidence extraction, so the decoupled pipeline and PATO updates could be sensitive to noisy or ambiguous diagrams.
paper_title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
